installCommand: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.24.0 --activate && if [ -f ../../pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then cd ../.. && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; else pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile; fi
buildCommand: code=0; pnpm run build>/tmp/b.txt 2>&1||code=$?; node post-log.js || true; exit $code
